map.投诉安抚：客户情绪激动时调「致歉安抚」类（如「非常抱歉给您带来了不好的体验，我们: Complaint de-escalation: when a customer is upset, use a script from the apology and reassurance category (for example, "We are very sorry for the bad experience and we fully understand how you feel; we will do everything to solve the problem"), empathise first and then solve, which lowers confrontation.
map.退款售后：确认退款后调「退款售后」类（如「退款申请已受理，款项将在3-5个工作日: Refunds and after-sales: after a refund is confirmed, use a script from the refund category (for example, "Your refund request has been accepted and the money will be returned to your original payment account within 3-5 business days"). map.：工具内置 18 条话术、按 6 类组织（开场问候 / 致歉安抚 / 问题处理: The tool ships with 18 scripts in 6 categories (opening greeting / apology and reassurance / problem handling / refunds and after-sales / information confirmation / closing, 3 each). Choose the apology and reassurance category and 3 scripts come back (for example "We are deeply sorry for the trouble this has caused…" and "We are truly sorry you had to wait so long…"); click any one to copy it. Switch to the refund category to see the corresponding refund timeline scripts, covering every node of a customer service conversation.
